$comment: Structure letters and presentation crops, per ultrasound scan.
Keyed by scan FILE NAME, not by muscle: one transverse view is shared by up to three
muscles (gastrocnemius and soleus; all three adductors), and the structures in the frame
are the same picture whichever muscle you arrived from.
Coordinates are SOURCE IMAGE PIXELS, the same convention us-label-boxes.json uses. That is
what lets a letter stay on its structure through any display size, the peel seam, a crop and
the zoom view. `crop` is [x, y, w, h] and is PRESENTATION ONLY: no file is ever re-cut, the
scan and its mask are drawn through one transform so a crop cannot pull the highlight out of
registration, and removing the crop restores the full frame.
Authored in the app (muscle page -> the scan's Label & crop action), exported from there, and
merged in with tools/pull_annotations.py, which validates bounds and letter uniqueness.
